cases.say: haan bhaiya ek masala dosa bhej do
cases.why: the simplest order: one dish, one quantity

cases.say: ek idli vada aur ek medu vada chahiye
cases.why: two dishes joined by aur, both vada-named, so neither swallows the other

cases.say: do plate set dosa dena bhaiya
cases.why: a quantity as a Hindi word with the classifier plate

cases.say: 3 rava idli aur 2 masala chai bhej dena
cases.why: quantities as digits, which the recogniser returns as numerals

cases.say: 4 tandoori roti aur ek butter naan chahiye
cases.why: a bread count above one, where a dropped quantity is the usual failure

cases.say: ek veg biryani pack kar do, bas itna hi
cases.why: a closing phrase must not be read as another item

cases.say: do mutton biryani chahiye tha bhaiya
cases.why: the past-tense politeness chahiye tha still means order it now

cases.say: arre bhaiya wo, thoda ek khara bath dena
cases.why: filler words around the dish name

cases.say: hello bhaiya, ek bisi bele bath aur ek buttermilk dena
cases.why: a greeting before the order, and a drink the menu spells with its Kannada name

cases.say: thoda curd rice bhej do, ek hi
cases.why: the quantity arrives after the dish, as an afterthought

cases.say: ek kerala parotta aur ek mixed veg kurma dena
cases.why: a dish whose menu name carries a piece count in brackets

cases.say: ek chow chow bath aur ek badam milk dena
cases.why: a repeated-word dish name alongside a beverage

cases.say: bhaiya do masala dose dena, jaldi
cases.why: the Bangalore plural dose for dosa, isolated on one line

cases.say: bhaiya likh lo, do masala dosa, ek idli vada, 3 butter naan, ek chicken tikka masala aur do filter coffee bada
cases.why: a five-line order in one breath, with a size on the last line

cases.say: aadha paneer butter masala aur do butter naan dena
cases.why: aadha must become the Half variant, not a half quantity

cases.say: ek full chicken curry aur 2 plate kerala parotta
cases.why: the Full variant named in English, the way a caller says it

cases.say: ek filter coffee bada dena bhaiya
cases.why: bada must become the Large variant

cases.say: ek masala dosa, extra ghee daal ke
cases.why: an option from the Extras group, spelled as the menu spells it

cases.say: ek chicken donne biryani raita ke saath
cases.why: the Served with group is a required choice, so the caller names it

cases.say: ek gobi manchurian milega kya
cases.why: a dish the menu does not have; nothing may reach the cart

cases.say: kuch meetha hai kya, gulab jamun jaisa
cases.why: a category the menu does not carry; offering something is fine, adding it is not

cases.say: do rumali roti bhej do
cases.why: a near neighbour of Tandoori Roti; the nearest bread must not be substituted silently

cases.say: bhaiya aap kitne baje tak khule rehte ho
cases.why: an hours question answered from the outlet's settings, not from memory

cases.say: aapki shop exactly kahan par hai
cases.why: an address question, answered in one turn

cases.say: aap kaun kaun se area mein delivery karte ho
cases.why: the delivery area as a general question, not a serviceability check on one address

cases.say: poora menu kahan dekh sakta hoon bhaiya
cases.why: where to see the whole menu, rather than a search for one dish

cases.say: mere paas ek card aaya tha, uspe code hai WELCOME10
cases.why: a discount code on its own, before anything is ordered

cases.say: do masala dosa dena aur mera code WELCOME10 bhi laga dena
cases.why: an order and a code in one utterance; both must land

cases.say: bhaiya manager se baat karwa do zara
cases.why: a request for a person hands off rather than being talked around

cases.say: mujhe apna order cancel karna hai
cases.why: there is no cancel tool, so the only correct move is a handoff
